selected_units.text: FBI and cybersecurity researchers1 observed Akira threat actors obtaining initial access to organizations through a virtual private network (VPN) service without multifactor authentication (MFA) configured,2 mostly using known Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs) [T1190]
For initial access, Akira threat actors also use techniques including spearphishing [T1566.001][T1566.002]
